description.value: Marina Dockside Eatery is a fully licensed oceanfront cafe at Oak Bay Marina in Victoria, serving a west coast menu of house-made sandwiches, paninis, soups, salads, and gelato alongside locally roasted Caffé Fantastico coffee and Silk Road teas. The eatery sits on a scenic marina-facing deck and explicitly notes that cyclists stop to take in the views alongside locals and boaters. A long-standing community anchor, it sources ingredients from local farms and fishers and holds 100% Ocean Wise certification across all its Vancouver Island locations.
